purpose: Schema, fact table and condition grammar of the flow table (core/flow.json and its per-layer overrides), id socratex-flow/v1
x-semantics: `needs` (optional) lists step ids this step depends on. After all layer overrides, a needed id that is missing, equal to the step itself or placed after it is an error that `sox flow check` reports with file and step id (so removing a step that others need is caught).
Steps run in array order. The agent sets the facts below as it learns them and re-checks the later steps; a step whose `when` holds must be done, one whose `when` does not hold is skipped.
A fact that is not known yet matches nothing (equality is false, `not` is true).

Overrides (local/overrides/flow.json, <project>/.socratex/flow.json, local/projects/<project>/flow.json) are applied in that order on top of core/flow.json. Their `steps` is an object with $remove (ids, a missing id is ignored), $delete (ids, a missing id is an error) and $append (full steps, an existing id is an error; optional `before` or `after` names a step id, default is the end). $remove and $delete run before $append, so remove plus append replaces a step.
x-condition-grammar: `when` is an object; an empty object always holds. Every key must hold (AND).

key = a fact name: scalar means equals (for a `set` fact: contains), a list means any of them, {"not": scalar-or-list} negates, {"gte": n} and {"lt": n} compare an `integer` fact, a boolean fact takes true or false.
key `all`: list of conditions, all hold. key `any`: list of conditions, at least one holds. key `not`: one condition, it does not hold.
x-actions: ask: stop and ask the owner (all open questions in one form, with a recommended default)
role:<name>: delegate to the routing role <name> (claude/agents/<name>.md or modules/routing/roles/<name>)
rule:<path>: open this rule document now (path relative to the repo root; a `project:` prefix is not checked)
gate:<name>: run a deterministic gate, one of x-gates
tool:<path>: run this repo tool (path relative to the repo root)

x-gates.fast: fast tests of the changed area

task_size.doc: trivial: one obvious edit; small: local and clear; medium: several files or steps; big: context above about 1500 lines, more than 3 substantial steps, or may outlive the session

touches.doc: areas the task changes; agent_config means settings, hooks, permissions, MCP or installs

unclear_requirements.doc: an unknown that changes the result and cannot be found in the repo

owner_answers.doc: the owner answered the question form and a plan exists

risk.doc: level printed by tools/risk_score.py for the diff

tier.doc: tier of the agent that produced the current result

gate.doc: result of the last deterministic gate

attempts_on_tier.doc: failed attempts on the current tier
